findings.evidence: Lines 370-437 are the whole descending section; `StrictAnti`/`descendingRegion` appear in no inclusion, integrability, zero or emptiness statement, while lines 211, 219, 246, 252 provide all four for `orderedRegion`. Roadmap README:627 states Δ_n(t,T) in the descending labelling and acceptance item 9 (:1203) is the product integral over that set.
findings.fix: Add `descendingRegion_subset_Icc` (same one-liner as line 246, using `hp.2`), `integrableOn_descendingRegion` (as at line 252), and `@[simp] descendingRegion_zero` / `@[simp] descendingRegion_eq_empty`, each provable in one line directly or via `rw [← preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion]`.
findings.issue: `descendingRegion` exposes only `mem_`, the preimage bridge, measurability, `setIntegral_descendingRegion`, `volume_` and the two identifications. The ascending counterparts `orderedRegion_zero` (211), `orderedRegion_eq_empty` (219), `orderedRegion_subset_Icc` (246) and `integrableOn_orderedRegion` (252) have no descending form, so a consumer holding the roadmap's own labelling cannot get `IntegrableOn g (descendingRegion T n t)` for a continuous `g`, nor simp the `n = 0` or `T ≤ t` cases, without detouring through `preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion` and `MeasurePreserving.integrableOn_comp_preimage` by hand.

findings.evidence: The file that consumes it has to invoke it manually twice: `simpa only [comp_rev_comp_rev]` at OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean:391 and `simp only [comp_rev_comp_rev]` at :411; upstream the corresponding `Fin.rev_involutive`/`Fin.rev_rev` pair is the simp normal form (used e.g. Mathlib/Order/Fin/Basic.lean:103).
findings.issue: `comp_rev_comp_rev : (p ∘ Fin.rev) ∘ Fin.rev = p` is the normal-form lemma for the exported coordinate reversal (strictly simpler RHS, no loop possible) but carries no `@[simp]`, so every consumer doing a change of variables along `measurableEmbedding_comp_rev` / `volume_preserving_comp_rev` must name it explicitly.

summary: The ascending-region API is complete and well annotated, and the earlier descending-labelling and placement findings are met. Two gaps remain: `descendingRegion` — the set the roadmap's acceptance item 9 is stated on — lacks the inclusion/integrability/zero/empty lemmas its ascending twin has, and the reversal normal-form lemma `comp_rev_comp_rev` is not `@[simp]`.
